source_validation_scope: Existing SRC-1..8 URLs are identifiers observed in the frozen fixture, not new document downloads or financial verification. Candidate landing pages were inspected where marked. No source licence is inferred from public accessibility.

CAND-EXCHANGE.observed: Official fee/licensing catalogue discovered; exact issuer/reference-data classification snapshot still required
CAND-EXCHANGE.rights: Reference-data and market display/derived/redistribution rights must be checked for chosen dataset

CAND-RESULTS.observed: 2025 results landing page inspected; no new numeric extraction
CAND-RESULTS.rights: Link and cite; republication of full content not approved

CAND-AUDIT.locator: Consolidated financial statements.pdf and auditor opinion

CAND-RISK.locator: Risk.pdf; Additional financial and legal information.pdf; financial statement notes

CAND-ESG.observed: Official 2025 data/assurance landing page explicitly distinguishes reporting boundaries and limited-assurance scope; 2021-2025 table and data/basis/assurance download links present
CAND-ESG.rights: Metric-level extraction/storage/display and document redistribution require separate review; assurance not transferable to all metrics

CAND-SECTOR.rights: Review dataset-specific redistribution and reuse conditions before acquisition

publisher_candidates: Chosen peer issuers' audited statements and operating reports
CAND-PEERS.rights: Official filings do not automatically grant redistribution of complete documents

CAND-MARKET.rights: Contract must cover historical/live display as applicable, storage, adjusted prices, derived analytics, benchmark and redistribution

CAND-CONSENSUS.rights: Estimates, targets, rating text, excerpts and history need explicit permission; a public report is not permission to aggregate/re-publish

CAND-VALUATION-INPUTS.rights: Inputs and model methodology approval separate from data access

CAND-NEWS.rights: Named source attribution, excerpt rights and storage/display rights required; issuer announcement differs from press opinion

common_derivation_gate: All inputs independently qualified to the required risk-based standard; source hashes/pages, source versions, restatement status and as-of publication dates pinned
Same entity/consolidation scope, currency, semantic definition, period start/end/kind, units and required dimensions
Named formula and method version, input identifiers/versions, execution timestamp and reproducible result in calculation lineage
Zero/negative denominators, missing inputs, source conflicts and accounting changes handled explicitly, no silent substitution
Result classified calculated, not issuer-reported; original input versions retained; no calculations added to UI in WEB08A
Frozen Preview deliberately withholds unapproved derivatives, even if historical lineage claims exist

recipes.definition: CFO - cash capex outflow magnitude (or CFO + signed negative capex); must choose and disclose sign convention
recipes.availability: CFO/capex shown in annual/latest-quarter/YTD topic groups, but current FCF is withheld; qualified-input certificate absent. Cash capex, PPE additions and issuer capital investment are not interchangeable.

recipes.definition: Chosen same-scope profit or CFO divided by same-period revenue or net income; denominator basis explicit
recipes.availability: Some inputs displayed, but affected derived fields are withheld. Retain withholding pending independent input and formula acceptance.

recipes.definition: Approved profit or NOPAT basis divided by approved average equity/assets/invested capital; do not relabel issuer ROACE as ROIC
recipes.availability: Balance/profit history sparse; opening balance and NOPAT method gaps remain

recipes.output: year-over-year growth, CAGR, TTM and Q4
recipes.definition: YoY over matching periods; CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_years)-1 only with valid endpoints and sign policy; Q4=FY-YTD9m for additive flow items only, never balance stocks, EPS or ratios by subtraction
recipes.availability: 2021-2025 provides four elapsed years, not a five-year CAGR; only two quarters and one current YTD, no YTD9m shown; TTM raw unavailable

recipes.definition: External segment revenue divided by reconciled group denominator; price-volume bridge requires compatible sold volumes, prices, FX, mix and intersegment eliminations
recipes.availability: Product/geography values shown for one FY; upstream/downstream raw keys are candidates, not yet validated. Do not infer sold volumes or percentages from unqualified inputs.

recipes.output: payout, dividend yield and dividend coverage
recipes.definition: DPS/EPS or total dividend/parent profit with consistently defined bases; trailing yield requires price as-of and adjusted dividend window; forward coverage requires approved forecasts
recipes.availability: Historical dividends shown; EPS withheld and price old; no forward forecast. Aggregate/base/performance-linked must not be double counted.

recipes.definition: P/E, P/B and EV/EBITDA only with approved metric definitions; EV equity value+qualifying debt+NCI/other adjustments-cash/nonoperating assets according to approved method
recipes.availability: Some shares/net debt/history rows shown but no complete verified bridge. No permission to calculate merely because a numerator exists.

recipes.definition: Approved return window, adjustment basis, benchmark, observation frequency and minimum sample policy
recipes.availability: 23 partial historical sessions and latest close are not a 52-week or robust beta dataset

recipes.definition: Approve FCFF versus FCFE, forecast horizon, nominal/real currency consistency, discounting convention, fiscal royalty/tax regime and terminal sustainability before any valuation
recipes.availability: Several critical inputs and methodologies missing or unverified; EPS/EBITDA/FCF remain withheld; no financial valuation approval
